# Bruno Moya

> Software Developer & Glassear Founder. Software developer based in Barcelona. Creator of Glassear and CTO at TopBrokers.io, working across web applications, backend systems, infrastructure and mixed reality.

Bruno Moya is based in Barcelona, Spain. He is CTO at TopBrokers.io and founder of Glassear. I started programming at 13. Building Glassear took me into optics, electronics and mixed reality; internships, university and professional projects broadened that work into web applications and production systems.

## Current work
- **CTO, TopBrokers.io** (2025-11 - Present): Hands-on technical ownership of production software and infrastructure, from architecture and implementation to deployment, validation and operations.
- **Founder & Software Developer, Glassear** (2015-05 - Present): Founded Glassear to build accessible mixed-reality glasses, working across custom hardware, computer vision, Unity and web applications.

## Selected projects
- [JobAgent - Autonomous AI Job Search & Application System](https://brunomoya.com/projects/jobagent/): An autonomous, agentic job-search platform for role discovery, semantic matching, job analysis, CV tailoring and controlled browser-assisted applications. Outcome: I use JobAgent to manage my own job search. [Repository](https://github.com/elblogbruno/JobAgent)
- [TalentGapAnalyzer - AI Workforce Intelligence](https://brunomoya.com/projects/talent-gap-analyzer/): AI-powered workforce intelligence and talent gap analysis platform built as a team project at UAB The Hack 2025. Outcome: Winner - UAB The Hack 2025 [Repository](https://github.com/OriolRoura/TalentGapAnalyzer-UABTheHack)
- [Glassear Studio - Natural Language to Interactive XR](https://brunomoya.com/projects/glassear-studio/): Glassear Studio translates natural-language intent into structured, synchronized changes to interactive XR applications. Outcome: An AI-native platform for building and modifying interactive XR applications across a web authoring environment and Unity runtime.

## Core skills
- **Backend & Distributed Systems:** Python, FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Celery, RabbitMQ
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- **Infrastructure:** Linux, Docker, Proxmox, PostgreSQL operations, Networking, Reverse proxies, Cloud infrastructure, Backup systems
- **XR & Spatial Computing:** Unity, AR Foundation, XR Interaction Toolkit, OpenXR, WebXR, Computer Vision, Custom XR hardware
- **AI tools & integration:** Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, LLM APIs, Agentic Workflows, Tool Calling, MCP, Structured Outputs, Prompt and System Instruction Design, Multi-Agent Workflows
